## Objectives

- obj-1: Explain what the commercial cloud adds to research and teaching, and how CloudBank removes the access and billing barriers (why-cloud, hpc-vs-cloud, what-weve-heard, what-is, why-choose, research-and-classroom, hub-vs-laptop, recap)
- obj-2: Guide a researcher through the decision path, from whether the cloud fits to a CloudBank allocation, onboarding and a planned exit (interview-simulation, decision-flowchart, eligibility, llm-hpc-vs-cloud, award-tiers, nairr, process, exit-plan, recap, getting-help)
- obj-3: Use generative AI to deploy cloud solutions, and design projects around storage, compute and network at the right level of abstraction (demo-roadmap, rice-use-case, genai-gaps, genai-prompt, deploy-with-ai, three-resources, abstraction-levels, ai-three-ways, same-client-code, skypilot-code, scaling-ladder, build-learn-advise, try-each-level, recap)
- obj-4: Anticipate common cloud pitfalls and steer researchers toward guardrails and open, shared resources (pitfalls-table, costs, key-safety, wrong-service, spot-the-pitfall, by-the-numbers, share-flow, shared-llm-tools, what-rice-shares, recap)
